audit.scope: Read-only design-conformance audit; only S2.json and evidence/S2 artifacts written.

runtime.actual: Target reachable. Onboarding completed. Home rendered at 393x852 in an API error state. Route crawl blocked by location setup/RN-web dismissal and unavailable prayer-times API.

contractFindings.finding: S2 requests 12dp contract; repository current spacing contract is 24dp.
Home displayed prayer-times error with gold Retry control; this is not a loaded happy-state route proof.
Dark rendered matrix and live no-reload switch were not verified.
51 of 52 routes and all 9 sheets/dialogs were not runtime reached.

tests.expected: 52 routes and 9 sheets/dialogs are represented.
tests.actual: Parsed inventory.json: 52 routes, 9 sheets/dialogs, 56 features, 50 source screen files.

tests.expected: Every route is rendered in both themes at required phone viewports.
tests.actual: Target was reachable and onboarding completed, but runtime remained at home/error-state; route crawl was blocked by the first-launch location sheet/RN-web touch dismissal and unavailable prayer-times API.

tests.expected: The audited spacing contract uses 12dp where specified.
tests.actual: Static/source contract conflict: repository spacing guard and existing implementation use a 24dp base contract; requested S2 contract is 12dp. No source edits made.
tests.notes: Recorded as conflict rather than silently treating 24dp as 12dp.

tests.expected: Only approved semantic palette literals are used; forbidden pure surfaces/controls absent.
tests.actual: Static scan found 102 distinct six-digit hex literals across source/config/content; runtime home shows cream surface and gold Retry control. Full route-level computed classification is blocked.

tests.expected: All rendered font families are in the audit allow-list and verified at runtime.
tests.actual: Source contains 146 font-family-related matches. Runtime route/font matrix was not reachable; allow-list conformance cannot be claimed.

tests.expected: Light/dark switch updates rendered colors without reload.
tests.actual: Isolated storage themeMode=dark reload did not yield a dark rendered surface before browser capture timeout; live no-reload switch was not reachable from the captured error state.

tests.expected: Exactly one FloatingNav frame exists and content clears it at midpoint and scroll end.
tests.actual: Home screenshot shows one bottom FloatingNav capsule. Midpoint/true-end clearance could not be measured because the captured route is a non-scrollable error state.
tests.notes: PASS only for visible one-frame observation; clearance remains unverified.
